title: Historic Photographs
description:
Sandy City Historic Photo clickable point locations from which photos were taken. Clicking brings up the images.

. 159 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Description
table:columns.description: Description of the feature, entered by city staff. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 159 rows, 110 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Date_Taken
table:columns.description: Date. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 159 rows, 32 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Angle
table:columns.description: Rotation angle of the symbol on the city's own maps. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 159 rows, 61 distinct values, ranging 0 to 358.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text note entered by city staff. Unstructured and inconsistently populated.

table:columns.name: People_in_Photo
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 19% of 159 rows, 30 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Building_Still_Exists
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 91% of 159 rows, 2 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Publish
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 159 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: URL
table:columns.description: Link to a page about this feature on a city or partner website.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
